objective.primaryRule: none: a bounded retrospective diagnostic of Priority 3's frozen subjects; nothing is searched, selected, ranked for selection, retuned or relabelled; Priority 3's frozen primary and classifications stand

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: no search (0 proposals). Frozen ceilings (brief §3): 4,000 fresh development simulations, 64 full-history simulations, 256 probe configurations (a subset of the development count), 4,000 observer book runs. Planned: development 1,176 (46 reproductions, 890 draw replays with their centres, 240 probes with their centres), FULL 10. Archive reads are counted apart and evaluate nothing.

deviations.description: no search, no earlier-cutoff repetition, no selection and no roles
deviations.justification: a diagnostic of frozen selections (§0.1); the brief forbids a search or a new winner

deviations.description: no new parity stage: Priority 3's evaluation code is reused unchanged under its frozen digests, and every replay must reproduce its sealed Priority 3 record field for field
deviations.justification: the engine is byte-identical to the frozen one; exact reproduction replaces a parity stage

deviations.description: no tuning benchmark; single-process contained stages
deviations.justification: the brief forbids a broad tuning benchmark for this bounded diagnostic; diagnostics report observed use (§6.3)

deviations.description: FULL is opened only to explain already-frozen subjects whose FULL results Priority 3 sealed, under Priority 3's frozen-selection guard, with the subjects and questions frozen in the protocol
deviations.justification: brief §3: retrospective explanation of frozen subjects; nothing is selected or ranked from that window
